svg.aria-label: The week on one page: how the platform pieces come together
svg.title: The week on one page: how the platform pieces come together
svg.text: one front door: find the services, their owners and docs, and the templates
Everything is code in Gitea. Every change is a pull request.
The platform checks it, then applies what main says.
A Ship a change to a service
C Ask for an exception to a rule
the plan is posted on the PR
the image, its scan, its SBOM
Your next change takes the same path
observe, learn, change again: back to step 2
you or your team do it
On Day 1 you ran hello by hand. By Day 6 every change, to code, environments or rules, took the same path: a template, a pull request, a check, and the platform applying main.
